law_name: Law No. 58 of 14 April 2008 on Personal Information
jurisdiction: State Agency for Personal Data Protection
applies_to: Holders (owners) and processors of personal data arrays
key_requirements: Consent of the subject; mandatory registration of personal data arrays and holders with the State Agency; security of personal data
enforcement_authority: State Agency for Personal Data Protection (Personal Data Protection Agency)
penalties_range: Administrative fines reported from May 2025, unverified (unconfirmed)
deceased_data: On state registration of death the subject gets 'deceased' status and data must be archived and stored (2022 amendment, Law No. 61); law replaced by Digital Code No. 178 from 5 Feb 2026
genetic_data: No specific rule: law has no clear definition of sensitive personal data; genetic data not named (unconfirmed)
notes: Last amendments seen 29 Nov 2021; EUI database says authority not yet established, conflicting with other sources
